text: The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal commenced hearing Appeal DDRT2021-09 at its June 17, 2021 meeting and adjourned consideration of the item to the August 19, 2021 meeting of the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal. Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, March 21, 2021, Appeal DDRT2021-09.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog, and directed that the conditions of the order remain in effect, and that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Julian Abdellatif and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before September 3, 2021.
